verses.1: And their hopes were shattered; they also lost their sight.
verses.2: Do not be cruel, for he will abandon us. And who is he, that he should stand before me?
verses.3: Who has gone before me? Let him be blessed under all the heavens. He is it.
verses.4: To him alone belongs the glory and honor.
verses.5: Who will bring his face out of the darkness? Who will come forth from this darkness?
verses.6: The doors of his face cannot be opened; around his eyes, there is only terror.
verses.7: Gāvah Afīqī Maginim Sagūr Chotham Tzar.
verses.8: One by one, they will come; but the spirit will not enter among them.
verses.9: Those who are brothers will be united and not separated from each other.
verses.10: His eyes were like black eyes, and his hair was black.
verses.11: From there, they will go to the flames; they will be burned by the fire.
verses.12: From his nostrils came smoke, like a billowing cloud.
verses.13: His soul is like a flame that burns brightly, and from his mouth flows fire.
verses.14: In his chest, there is strength; before him, there is a sign of greatness.
verses.15: May his words be kept pure; may they not be corrupted or tainted.
verses.16: His heart was filled with pain, like a stone that has been crushed underfoot.
verses.17: From their mouths, gods will be driven away; they will be destroyed.
verses.18: They try to get them, but without having any ships or means of transportation.
verses.19: It is considered to be a metal blade for the tree of life.
verses.20: Let not the son of Kashim flee from us. They have turned him into a stone.
verses.21: They are considered to be mere noises, and they can be played to make noise.
verses.22: Below him are the deep foundations that support the structure.
verses.23: A bowl of salt will be placed on the sea, and it will become a source of nourishment.
verses.24: After that, Yair will be considered a leader who can lead others.
verses.25: There is no one who can make it happen, without any effort.
verses.26: He who is above all heights will be king over all children of Shachat.
